name: DENC7
title: DEN.C7 Initial management
description: Questionnaire for the DEN.C7 Initial management activity, based on the DEN.C7 data elements.

text.div:
Implementation notes and pending items

Pending decisions and terminology checks for DEN.C7 Initial management:

  • Hydration requiredness: DEN.C7.1.DE1 is marked required, while its option rows DEN.C7.1.DE2 and DE3 are marked required and DE4 is optional. A single-select question cannot require each alternative independently. The parent requirement is implemented; confirm what the option-level markers mean.
  • Management requiredness: DEN.C7.2.DE1 has no requiredness value. Its option rows mix Optional and blank values. The question remains optional pending clarification; blank source cells are not interpreted as requirements.
  • No hydration meaning: DEN.C7.1.DE4 combines “Not indicated” and “not yet initiated”. These situations can differ clinically, but the source supplies one answer option and no rule to distinguish them; the Questionnaire preserves that option as written.
  • Terminology mappings: ICD-11 is marked not classifiable for DEN.C7.1.DE1 and its options and for DEN.C7.2.DE2–DE5; the DEN.C7.2.DE1 cell is blank. ICD-10, LOINC, and ICF option rows are marked not classifiable and question-row cells are blank. No targets are asserted for those systems. The supplied SNOMED CT codes are represented as candidate related-to mappings, not validated equivalents; numeric spreadsheet values are normalized to digit-string SCTIDs in the ConceptMaps. The care-level options map to SNOMED environment concepts, which may not represent management decisions; review before production.
  • Storage choice: QuestionnaireResponse remains the raw answer. A receiving system may derive a BR-Core Observation from each coded response as an implementation choice; resource generation is not specified by the source. This does not assert a Procedure, Encounter, or admission. The source does not supply an effective time, performer, or Observation.status. A receiving system must populate the BR-Core-required status; the example uses final only to demonstrate a valid instance. The examples omit effective time and performer because the source does not provide them.
  • Decision support: The source provides no skip logic or executable decision rules for these items. The questionnaire records the selected answers without deriving one from the other.
  • Terminology validation: Candidate SNOMED CT targets have not been independently validated against a terminology server.

item.text: Starts hydration — Indicates whether hydration therapy has been initiated for a patient with suspected or confirmed dengue.
Define management — Define management categories aligned with severity classification and available resources.
